opening.argument: The presentation promotes the OneCoin Infinity Trader package through claims that Infinity+ can significantly increase tokens and coins, while offering a free Infinity Code to viewers who bank eight codes. The speaker states that users can "significantly increase your tokens and in turn, your coins" and that "If you bank 8 codes, you'll get one free Infinity Code." It also presents CoinSafe as a way to earn both a deposit rate on coin balances and gains from a rising currency value, connecting those asserted benefits to further information about the offering. Together, these are purchase and appreciation claims that support the alleged token-investment scheme. The available record does not establish prices, complete terms, completed transactions, or resulting value, so the conclusion rests on the promotional claims and incentives actually presented, without overclaiming losses or outcomes.
